in_hebrew.name: Jill
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Gem of the Earth
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jill הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Jill is derived from the Old English word gil, meaning pledge or deposit. It was later influenced by the Old Norse name Gylla, meaning gracious or kind. The name Jill has been associated with the earth, as a jill was a young heifer or cow, and the name was given to girls born on the feast day of St. Jill, which was celebrated on the first of May. In folklore, Jill was a name for a fairy who would grant wishes to those who left offerings of milk for her.

in_latin.name: Jill
in_latin.meaning: Femina Anglicana, forma feminina nominis Jillius, in lingua Anglicana usitata
in_latin.long_meaning: Jill significat 'femina Anglicana' vel 'forma feminina nominis Jillius', quae in lingua Anglicana adhuc usitatur. Nomen Jillius, a feminino Jill, oriundum est a nominativo masculino Jillio, quo nomen a Jillio, forma masculina nominis, deductum est. Jillius forma nominis feminini in lingua Anglicana etiam usitata est.
